title: Hatsune Miku — How About Tickling?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Whoa...! Those look adorable!
They all look so well made too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you should have no trouble dancing in these since they made them using a slightly elastic fabric, and this tulle's so pretty.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They must've put so much care into making these. It's clear just based on the attention to detail.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I almost cried after I saw how amazing these were...!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They have these adorable outfits now, and they're about to get a new song next...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what the girls' second real-life show is going to be like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, for example...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They could run the stage end to end or interact with their fans by calling out to them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, they could do a quick costume change too! It can even be a race to see who can head back, change and return the fastest!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a feeling it's going to be a wonderful event where all of their fans will have dazzling smiles on their faces.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thinking about them putting on a fun show is making me want to sing now♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Speaking of which, I've been singing with Rin and the others a lot lately...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (So it might be good for me to fly solo and do a show on my own for a change!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I may even make some new discoveries by revisiting my roots.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it might be fun to try some new things too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But what? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I could jump with all my fans!
No, that isn't all that new...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We can do cheers together, but I use mine during shows all the time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I could try some different stage effects, like releasing a bunch of balloons or changing out the lights!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No...
That's pretty much been done before too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't think of anything.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Miku?
You look like you have a lot on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO...? And Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But why? We didn't make plans to practice together, did we?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, we didn't. I'm here to practice on my own.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I decided to come talk to you since you seem concerned about something...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was about to do the same thing when I bumped into her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
Thank you both for showing so much concern for me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, what's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, something new for your own show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's a tough one.
I mean, you've done so many shows in SEKAI already.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know. I've been putting a lot of thought into it, but I keep coming up with things I've already done or tried...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sorry, Haruka. I know you want to get in some practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's okay. You're always there for me, so I'd like to help out somehow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Fear not. I'm sure the three of us will be able to come up with a good idea if we put our heads together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First, Miku, mind telling us what you want to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your theme this time around is to “revisit your roots” and feel some sort of “nostalgia”?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but it doesn't have to be all new. I'd be happy with even just one thing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... Like feeling a sense of nostalgia when we compare your past and current selves?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, but nostalgia and new are very different things.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there anything that'll help show everyone that I'm the same but not, or how I'm still me with some new things to offer?

rows.Speaker: Miku, Haruka & KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm...
Ah, there you are...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka's with you♪
Perfect!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mind taking a look at our dance routine?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?
